crossRefs.note: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die…

translations.web: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”
translations.bsb: Some were saying, “We and our sons and daughters are numerous. We must get grain in order to eat and stay alive.”
translations.kjv: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
translations.asv: For there were that said, We, our sons and our daughters, are many: let us get grain, that we may eat and live.
